Rachel / team — I reviewed the customer's redlines and attached a short memo (RI_SCCs_Addendum_Draft.pdf) with suggested responses. High level comments below — please treat as counsel-level guidance, not final language.

1) Transfers: SCCs + Redwood Addendum works for us. We should avoid open-ended commitments about other transfer mechanisms (e.g., Privacy Shield-type references). Proposed counter: accept SCCs but add an addendum that (a) documents the exporter/importer roles and (b) enumerates supplemental safeguards (encryption at rest/in-transit, contractual security obligations).

2) Subprocessors: customer's redline requires prior written consent for any subprocessor change. For operational reasons, we push for "notice with 30-day objection window" for enterprise accounts. If customer insists on prior consent, be prepared for an exception to procurement (can be scoped in the SOW).

3) Retention & deletion: customer wants prescriptive retention buckets by data category. We can offer a default retention schedule in the DPA with the option to override in the SOW for regulated use-cases. Recommend proposing a 2-tier approach: default + customer-specific retention in SOW.

4) Audit rights: their redline requests on-site audits. We should counter with right to an independent third-party assessment (SOC2 report + summary of scope) and allow on-site audits only for material breach with advance notice and costs borne by customer.

5) Breach notifications: customer requires 24-hour notification. We should commit to "best efforts" to notify within 48 hours of confirmed breach and provide updates.

6) Liability cap carve-outs: ensure security/privacy carve-outs are clearly spelled out and align with our existing commercial terms.

Action items: I can produce an annotated redline to return to Alicia by EOD tomorrow (15 Jul) and draft the SCCs addendum. Priyom — please confirm if FinTech Prospect needs execution via DocuSign (Rachel already flagged they prefer this).

Neha Kapoor

- Transfers: SCCs + Addendum is acceptable; we'll want to review the addendum text quickly to ensure there are no gaps around onward transfer scenarios (e.g., subprocessors in APAC).
